data.title: NMP Acquisition Updates Business Combination Agreement Timeline
data.description:
NMP Acquisition Corp. Class A ( (NMP) ) has shared an announcement.

On September 22, 2026, NMP Acquisition Corp., Pubco and GTS amended their September 4, 2026 Business Combination Agreement to extend to October 9, 2026 the deadline for delivering audited financial statements for both GTS and Pubco to NMP, with NMP retaining unilateral discretion to grant further extensions by written notice. The amendment also resets all references to the “Audit Delivery Date,” ties the required filing of the registration statement to five business days after that date, and clarifies that prior delays in delivering audited financials do not constitute a breach or basis for terminating the deal, effectively preserving the business combination’s timetable and reducing near-term execution risk for the parties and their stakeholders.

The parties reiterated that Pubco and GTS intend to file a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, including a proxy statement and prospectus for NMP shareholders to vote on the proposed business combination and related matters. They also noted that NMP, GTS, OpCo and Pubco, along with certain directors, officers and equity holders, may be deemed participants in the proxy solicitation, underscoring the ongoing regulatory process around the transaction and the need for investors to rely on formal SEC filings for detailed information.
